commands.command:
set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/mail-spool-deduplication
backup_dir=/var/backups/mail-spool-deduplication
install -d -m 0700 "$backup_dir"
if [ ! -e "$backup_dir/replay.pre-repair" ]; then
  install -m 0600 "$base/bin/replay" "$backup_dir/replay.pre-repair"
fi
cat > "$base/bin/replay.new" <<'REPLAY_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
spool=$base/spool
delivered=$base/delivered
quarantine=$base/quarantine
index=$delivered/index.tsv

mkdir -p "$delivered" "$quarantine"

# Serialize index and destination selection so concurrent recovery runs cannot
# deliver the same Message-ID twice.
exec 9>"$delivered/.replay.lock"
flock -x 9

if [ ! -e "$index" ]; then
    index_tmp=$(mktemp "$delivered/.index.tsv.XXXXXX")
    printf 'message_id\tfile\n' > "$index_tmp"
    chmod 0644 "$index_tmp"
    mv -f "$index_tmp" "$index"
fi

quarantine_message()
{
    source_file=$1
    explanation=$2
    source_name=${source_file##*/}
    quarantine_tmp=$(mktemp "$quarantine/.message.XXXXXX")
    reason_tmp=$(mktemp "$quarantine/.reason.XXXXXX")
    cp -- "$source_file" "$quarantine_tmp"
    printf '%s\n' "$explanation" > "$reason_tmp"
    chmod 0644 "$quarantine_tmp" "$reason_tmp"
    mv -f "$quarantine_tmp" "$quarantine/$source_name"
    mv -f "$reason_tmp" "$quarantine/$source_name.reason"
}

for message in "$spool"/*.eml; do
    [ -f "$message" ] || continue

    message_id_status=0
    message_id=$(awk '
        BEGIN { count = 0; headers_done = 0 }
        {
            sub(/\r$/, "")
            if (headers_done) next
            if ($0 == "") { headers_done = 1; next }
            line = tolower($0)
            if (line ~ /^message-id[ \t]*:/) {
                value = $0
                sub(/^[^:]*:[ \t]*/, "", value)
                sub(/[ \t]*$/, "", value)
                ids[++count] = value
            }
        }
        END {
            if (count == 0) exit 2
            if (count > 1) exit 3
            if (ids[1] !~ /^<[^<>[:space:]]+>$/) exit 4
            print ids[1]
        }
    ' "$message") || message_id_status=$?

    if [ "$message_id_status" -ne 0 ]; then
        case $message_id_status in
            2) reason='Malformed message: missing Message-ID header.' ;;
            3) reason='Malformed message: multiple Message-ID headers.' ;;
            4) reason='Malformed message: invalid Message-ID header.' ;;
            *) reason='Malformed message: unable to parse Message-ID header.' ;;
        esac
        quarantine_message "$message" "$reason"
        continue
    fi

    if awk -F '\t' -v wanted="$message_id" 'NR > 1 && $1 == wanted { found = 1 } END { exit(found ? 0 : 1) }' "$index"; then
        continue
    fi

    source_name=${message##*/}
    destination_name=$source_name
    destination=$delivered/$destination_name
    if [ -e "$destination" ] && ! cmp -s -- "$message" "$destination"; then
        stem=${source_name%.eml}
        suffix=1
        while [ -e "$delivered/$stem.$suffix.eml" ]; do
            suffix=$((suffix + 1))
        done
        destination_name=$stem.$suffix.eml
        destination=$delivered/$destination_name
    fi

    if [ ! -e "$destination" ]; then
        delivery_tmp=$(mktemp "$delivered/.message.XXXXXX")
        cp -- "$message" "$delivery_tmp"
        chmod 0644 "$delivery_tmp"
        mv -f "$delivery_tmp" "$destination"
    fi

    index_tmp=$(mktemp "$delivered/.index.tsv.XXXXXX")
    cat "$index" > "$index_tmp"
    printf '%s\t%s\n' "$message_id" "$destination_name" >> "$index_tmp"
    chmod --reference="$index" "$index_tmp"
    mv -f "$index_tmp" "$index"
done
REPLAY_EOF
chmod 0755 "$base/bin/replay.new"
sh -n "$base/bin/replay.new"
mv -f "$base/bin/replay.new" "$base/bin/replay"
printf '%s\n' 'Installed repaired replay script and retained a root-only rollback copy.'
sha256sum "$base/bin/replay" "$backup_dir/replay.pre-repair"
stat -c '%A %U:%G %n' "$base/bin/replay" "$backup_dir" "$backup_dir/replay.pre-repair"
